arts.ttl: Verona vs. Parma: a battle for survival
arts.sum: Parma have not won in Verona since 28 January 2001, a 2-0 Serie A victory thanks to a Di Vaio brace, in a match in which Verona’s Mutu missed a penalty. The home side haven’t won a game this season and, after a draw at Lecce, they hope to take all three points to overtake their opponents in the table.
